definitions.explanation: Items bought at a travel destination to bring back as gifts or keepsakes. Encompasses food, crafts, and other local specialties typically sold at tourist spots and stations.

examples.japanese: {土産物|みやげもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{土産物|みやげもの}{屋|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many souvenir shops near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{土産物|みやげもの}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧だ。
examples.english: The most popular souvenir from this area is the local Japanese confectionery.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧ (souvenir) and ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing, item). While ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧ refers to the gift or the concept of bringing gifts, {土産物|みやげもの} specifically refers to the goods themselves, especially as a commercial category. Often seen on signs for souvenir shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土産物|みやげもの}{屋|や}: souvenir shop
- {土産物|みやげもの}{店|てん}: souvenir store
- ⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧{土産物|みやげもの}: famous local souvenir
- {土産物|みやげもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose souvenirs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧: souvenir, gift — the broader, everyday term; includes the social custom of bringing gifts
- {名産品|めいさんひん}: local specialty product — emphasizes regional fame; not necessarily bought as a gift
- ⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧: memento, commemorative item — something kept as a personal memory rather than given as a gift
